text: Amit Vulkan a few years ago I had to wait 5 months to get invited. Make sure the documents are all super in order. Better to provide more than less. When my ex handed everything in they were not allowed to be older than three months. The process takes a while and you need a lot of patience. It could take a year until your partner can actually work- but might be faster. And once you have the visa you should not be out of the Israel for more than 90 days per year.
